name: West Virginia
standard: ADA Title II floor (WCAG 2.1 AA); WV.gov states Section 508 conformance. No WVOT accessibility standard found.

laws.summary: Authorizes the CIO/Office of Technology to issue IT policies for executive branch agencies; no accessibility policy was found among them.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

applies_to: WV.gov and state agency websites (statement); executive branch agencies for WVOT policies. Local governments via the ADA Title II floor.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Section 508-based features on WV.gov (alt text, resizing, accessible documents)
mobile: not addressed — no mobile language in state materials.
procurement: No state accessibility procurement clause found.
enforcement: WV.gov Digital Accessibility Request Form or agency contact; WV Relay; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: The WVOT policy catalog lists no accessibility policy. No WV statute sets a web standard; the WV Legislature site self-reports WCAG 2.0 AA.
